mapper.select: WITH target_user AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN 'AGE_20_24' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN 'AGE_25_29' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN 'AGE_30_34' END AS age_group FROM miraero_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} ), peer_users AS ( SELECT peer.user_id FROM miraero_user peer CROSS JOIN target_user target WHERE CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, peer.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN 'AGE_20_24' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, peer.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN 'AGE_25_29' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, peer.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN 'AGE_30_34' END = target.age_group AND peer.user_id != #{userId} ), peer_category_expenses AS ( SELECT peer.user_id, transaction_data.expense_category_id AS category_id, SUM(transaction_data.amount) AS total_amount FROM peer_users peer JOIN `transaction` transaction_data ON transaction_data.user_id = peer.user_id WHERE transaction_data.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND transaction_data.transacted_at >= #{startDateTime} AND transaction_data.transacted_at < #{endDateTime} GROUP BY peer.user_id, transaction_data.expense_category_id ) SELECT category.expense_category_id AS categoryId, category.category_name AS categoryName, CAST(FLOOR( (benchmark.baseline_average_amount * benchmark.baseline_weight + COALESCE(SUM(peer_category_expenses.total_amount), 0)) / (benchmark.baseline_weight + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM peer_users)) ) AS SIGNED) AS peerAverageAmount FROM target_user JOIN peer_spending_benchmark benchmark ON benchmark.age_group = target_user.age_group JOIN expense_category category ON category.expense_category_id = benchmark.expense_category_id LEFT JOIN peer_category_expenses ON peer_category_expenses.category_id = category.expense_category_id GROUP BY category.expense_category_id, category.category_name, benchmark.baseline_average_amount, benchmark.baseline_weight ORDER BY category.expense_category_id ASC
